do: const S = __logStore.getState(); for (const id of Object.keys(S.logs)) S.removeLog(id); const [x, z] = __wb.site, [rx, rz] = __wb.right, [fx, fz] = __wb.fwd; const yawF = Math.atan2(fx, fz); const qLie = (yaw, up) => { const h = yaw / 2, ay = [0, Math.sin(h), 0, Math.cos(h)]; const s = Math.SQRT1_2, qx = [ up ? -s : s, 0, 0, s]; const m = (a, b) => [a[3]*b[0] + a[0]*b[3] + a[1]*b[2] - a[2]*b[1], a[3]*b[1] - a[0]*b[2] + a[1]*b[3] + a[2]*b[0], a[3]*b[2] + a[0]*b[1] - a[1]*b[0] + a[2]*b[3], a[3]*b[3] - a[0]*b[0] - a[1]*b[1] - a[2]*b[2]]; return m(ay, qx); }; const q = qLie(yawF, true); const at = (k) => { const px = x + rx * (k - 2) * 0.75, pz = z + rz * (k - 2) * 0.75; return [px, t.groundAt(px, pz), pz]; }; const put = (id, k, piece, lift) => { const [px, g, pz] = at(k); return { id, bark: '#5b4a38', state: 'placed', position: [px, g + lift, pz], rotation: q, ...piece }; }; S.addLogs([ put('pc-log', 0, { kind: 'log', length: 2.4, radius: 0.2, notches: 'both' }, 0.2), put('pc-plank', 1, { kind: 'plank', length: 2.4, radius: 0.13 }, 0.03), put('pc-roof', 2, { kind: 'roof', length: 2.4, radius: 0.12 }, 0.03), put('pc-post', 3, { kind: 'post', length: 1.0, radius: 0.14 }, 0.14), put('pc-door', 4, { kind: 'door', length: 1.85, radius: 0.46 }, 0.04) ]); await t.key('Space', 60); await t.wait(90); await t.key('Space', 60); const [cx, g0, cz] = at(2); t.teleport(cx - fx * 2.6, g0 + 2.4, cz - fz * 2.6); await t.frames(20); t.lookAt(cx, g0, cz); await t.frames(20); return 1;
